environment.runtime_mode: IRQ-enabled system mode with Thumb calls

experiments.trigger: Fill the runtime custom slot with 64 bytes of 0xA5 and invoke Task8_ValidateOrDefaultSlot.
experiments.conclusion: The current native module rejects corrupt state and restores the byte-exact canonical SU8C default slot.

experiments.trigger: In three independent emulator sessions, write a valid distinct SU8C state, invoke the retail save transaction at 0x08044DAC, overwrite the runtime slot with 0xA5, and invoke the retail load path at 0x0804504C.
experiments.conclusion: The current seal, scatter, gather, validate, and default integration survives three complete retail save/load cycles without using EEPROM tail blocks.

experiments.trigger: Invoke Task8_NameCommitHook with the stable 16-byte EWRAM string ABCDEFGHIJKLMNO\0, a valid sequence-33 custom slot, the retail destination, and maximum length 16.
experiments.conclusion: The native wrapper preserves the retail string-copy behavior and commits a resealed 12-byte persistent player name without disturbing unrelated custom state.

experiments.trigger: Pre-clear the retail destination as the original handler does, then invoke the wrapper with Bad!\0 followed by zero padding.
experiments.conclusion: Invalid persistent input cannot activate corrupt custom state; retail behavior remains intact while the protected slot defaults.

rejected_observation.description: An initial direct-call attempt used 0x03007E00 as the source buffer and appeared to persist only eight characters.
rejected_observation.cause: The chosen IWRAM range was active during interrupts and was overwritten during the call.
rejected_observation.resolution: Repeating the same call with stable EWRAM at 0x0203F000 preserved all 16 retail bytes and the expected 12 persistent bytes.

remaining_runtime_gate.required_action: Reach the existing Enter name scene through live UI, enter a distinctive name, and confirm the patched branch naturally reaches 0x08400078 before returning to 0x08066966.
